analysis: The PR modifies only docs/developer/test.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3), adds GLM5NextLogprobsTests and NativeOutputControlRefusalTests documentation near line 117, and adds a returned-reasoning / OpenRouter test paragraph near line 182 (the patch excerpt is truncated; head lines 182-209 are not visible in the supplied base text). No executable code, configuration, workflow or trust-boundary behavior changes. Documentation describes tests only: logprobs via the protected native bridge/relay channel (one entry per generated token, row not drafting, later plain request still speculating) and a typed 400 for engines lacking logprob capture (MiMo). These are test descriptions and do not weaken controls in T-008 (plaintext on encryption failure), T-041 (prefix cache), A-001 (prompts/completions) or TB-002/TB-007. The doc keeps guidance to use synthetic fixtures, isolated state and no production credentials. One residual question for integration: the logprobs relay path returns token-level data to consumers via the coordinator relay; whether it is sealed and whether logprobs interact with the prefix-cache/TTFT oracle (T-041) cannot be judged from this docs-only diff. Production code is not supplied, so I record that as an unverified contract, not a finding. Also, the added head text for lines 182-209 was not available beyond the truncated excerpt, so the reasoning-content paragraph was not fully reviewed. No findings.
